name: phil/accessibility-statement-bundle
description: The accessibility statement of a Symfony application: versioned, from configuration or a table, at /accessibility and /accessibilite in English and French with the wording of WCAG, EN 301 549 or the Accessible Canada Act, drawn with the PHIL UX kit, a footer link, an admin page that publishes, and a command fed by phil/accessibility-check

suggest.doctrine/orm: For the "doctrine" source, the versions kept in a table
suggest.phil/contact-form-bundle: For a contact form to name as the page that takes feedback
suggest.phil/forms-bundle: For a form of its own that takes feedback, linked from the page
suggest.phil/legal-notices-bundle: For the statement among the legal links of a footer
suggest.phil/ux-kit: For the recipes the templates draw — Alert, Badge, Button, Card, Field, Table, Textarea —, through the Symfony UX Toolkit; or the same recipes from the Shadcn kit of the Toolkit, on Tailwind
suggest.symfony/console: For phil:accessibility-statement:generate, the next version written from the latest audit
suggest.symfony/security-bundle: For the administration page, behind a role
suggest.symfony/security-csrf: For the form of the administration page
suggest.symfony/translation: For the page in English and French
